posts.title: How to Make Making Webcomics a Habit
posts.description: How do you turn working on your webcomic into a sustainable, long-term practice? Most webcomics take years to complete. Creating good working processes for your webcomic will help you stick with it for the long haul. posts.title: Pacing in Webcomics: A Primer
posts.description: A fast-paced thriller. A slow-burn drama. A bloated third act. A volume-long fight scene. A story likely popped in your head when you read those descriptions, right? These are all examples of pacing—the speed at which a story unfolds.
